name: 048_tv_chartart_rsi_bb_long_v12_tf1
hypothesis: TradingView port T5 (PLAN.md section 13) from the Pine v3 source the owner supplied: 'Bollinger + RSI, Double Strategy Long-Only (by ChartArt) v1.2'. Same entry as T1 (v1.1): long when RSI(6) crosses above 50 on the same bar as the close crosses up through the lower 200-bar, 2-sd Bollinger band. Long only. EXIT as the script writes it: strategy.close when RSI(6) crosses below 50 on the same bar as the close crosses down through the upper band - the port uses the owner-approved engine feature exit_on 'opposite' (the opposite trigger closes the long at the next open). The author notes long-only 'made it more successful in backtesting' - on a rising market that is the expected effect of being long, which baseline.py and benchmark.py test. DEVIATIONS: the script has no stop; every trade must risk 1%, so a pct stop (4%/6%) is added as the mandatory stop, and a long time cap; the stop-order entry at the lower band fills at the next open (price has already crossed it); TradingView's default commission is 0, here 0.05% taker + 0.02% slippage + funding. Source chart 4h; variants in chart mode. [Timeframe variant of 048_tv_chartart_rsi_bb_long_v12, 240m -> 1m, mode chart: same bar counts and ATR multiples, hold x0.00416667, pct stop x0.065.]
